# StatementsMixin { #timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin }

```python
timelines.StatementsMixin()
```

The statements of a bundle, a timeline or a region, and their provenance.

A holder stores exactly the file's two keys (``_statement_state``:
``statements`` and ``provenance``, each only when not empty) and the
prefixes its pairs need beyond the catalogue's (``_prefixes``). Reading
and every change run TimeToShare's functions on a one-subject document
built from the holder's own state: its ``@context`` holds the format's
terms, the catalogue's prefixes and the holder's own, and the holder is
the subject ``()``.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [prefixes](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.prefixes) | The prefixes declared on this holder beyond the catalogue's, sorted. |
| [provenance](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.provenance) | The provenance entries, in their order; a copy, ``[]`` when none. |
| [statements](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.statements) | The pairs stated, ``{property: [value, ...]}``, keys in code-point order. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_candidates](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_candidates) | Return the candidates: the entries of pairs the holder does not state. |
| [get_pairs](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_pairs) | Return the pairs ``(property, value)`` of the holder or of a value node. |
| [get_provenance](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_provenance) | Return the provenance entries of the holder or of a value node. |
| [get_rectangles](#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_rectangles) | Return the holder's pairs gathered by verb: one verb about one thing. |

### get_candidates { #timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_candidates }

```python
timelines.StatementsMixin.get_candidates(
    node=(),
    believer=None,
    beliefs=DEFAULT_BELIEFS,
)
```

Return the candidates: the entries of pairs the holder does not state.

A candidate is offered for someone to state (:meth:`add_statement`
with the same pair). With *believer* and the default *beliefs*, a
candidate the believer believes ``"false"`` is left out: it is not
offered to that actor again (:func:`timetoshare.candidates` with
``actor=``).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                                   | Description                                                                              | Default           |
|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| node     | [NodePath](`timetoalign.timelines.statements.NodePath`)                                | The value node whose candidates to return; ``()`` the holder.                            | `()`              |
| believer | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                   | The actor whose beliefs filter, an IRI (compact or absolute); every candidate when None. | `None`            |
| beliefs  | [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[BeliefState](`timetoshare.BeliefState`)\] | The states kept, as for :meth:`get_provenance`.                                          | `DEFAULT_BELIEFS` |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                           |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *node* addresses no value node, or *beliefs* is not a collection of belief states. |

### get_pairs { #timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_pairs }

```python
timelines.StatementsMixin.get_pairs(node=())
```

Return the pairs ``(property, value)`` of the holder or of a value node.

Keys in code-point order, values in list order; each ``type`` item
is a pair ``("type", iri)`` (:func:`timetoshare.pairs`).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                    | Description                                              | Default   |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| node   | [NodePath](`timetoalign.timelines.statements.NodePath`) | The value node whose pairs to return; ``()`` the holder. | `()`      |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                        |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *node* addresses no value node. |

### get_provenance { #timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_provenance }

```python
timelines.StatementsMixin.get_provenance(
    node=(),
    believer=None,
    beliefs=DEFAULT_BELIEFS,
)
```

Return the provenance entries of the holder or of a value node.

Entries of stated pairs and candidates alike, in their order
(:func:`timetoshare.entries`), kept by the belief filter.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default           |
|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| node     | [NodePath](`timetoalign.timelines.statements.NodePath`)                                | The value node whose entries to return; ``()`` the holder.                                                                                                                                                    | `()`              |
| believer | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                   | The actor whose beliefs filter, an IRI (compact or absolute); every entry when None.                                                                                                                          | `None`            |
| beliefs  | [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[BeliefState](`timetoshare.BeliefState`)\] | The states kept: the entries of pairs whose state for the believer (``"true"``, ``"undecided"`` where the believer holds no belief, ``"unlikely"``, ``"false"``) is one of them; default all but ``"false"``. | `DEFAULT_BELIEFS` |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                           |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *node* addresses no value node, or *beliefs* is not a collection of belief states. |

### get_rectangles { #timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin.get_rectangles }

```python
timelines.StatementsMixin.get_rectangles(catalogue=None)
```

Return the holder's pairs gathered by verb: one verb about one thing.

Pairs a catalogue reads as one verb about one thing, in whatever
vocabularies, form one rectangle; the ``is_a`` rectangle comes
first (:func:`timetoshare.rectangles`).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                         | Description                                                      | Default   |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| catalogue | [Catalogue](`timetoshare.Catalogue`) \| None | The catalogue to read the pairs with; the shipped one when None. | `None`    |
